Container.Name: BingeBandit
Container.Overview: Self-hosted media server: movies and TV with direct play and transcoding, live TV from M3U/XMLTV with a cable-style guide and DVR, custom channels, Trakt sync and imports from Plex/Tautulli. Apps for Android TV, Fire TV and Android phones. Setup guide: docs/UNRAID.md in the project.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The web app and the API. Keep it at 8484 so the TV and phone apps find the server by themselves.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, artwork, caches, logs and backups.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your movies and TV. Add libraries in the web app with paths under /media (e.g. /media/movies). Read-only is fine.

Config.Name: DVR recordings
Config.Description: Optional: where live TV recordings are saved. Leave empty to keep them in appdata.

Config.Name: Transcode folder
Config.Description: Optional: temporary conversion files. /tmp keeps them in RAM (needs a few GB free); leave empty to use appdata.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU
Config.Description: Optional: hardware transcoding with Intel Quick Sync or AMD. Set to /dev/dri, then choose VAAPI under Server, Settings.

Config.Name: Update repository
Config.Description: Where the TV and phone apps look for app updates (GitHub owner/repo). Empty turns in-app updates off.
